lines.t: Yeah…
You say His Name, but you don’t know Him.
Turned the Living One into a cold stone statue.
This a lament for a dead church with a living God outside the door.
You say “Lord, Lord,” but you don’t know Him at all,
Raised up steeples, but you killed His call.
Turned His face into stone, made His voice so small,
But He still walks in the fire, yeah, He sees it all.You made God like you, with your fear and pride,
Put Him up in a box, left Him locked inside.
But He’s breaking through the walls that you fortified,
Every idol ‘bout to fall when the King arrives.
You dress Him up nice in your Sunday suit,
Polished doctrine on your lips, but your heart’s mute.
You preach power, but you fold when the storm hit,
Whole congregation full of doubt, call it “wisdom” and “logic.”You don’t want fire, you just want a safe brand,
Tryna manage El Shaddai with a business plan.
Turned the Potter to a product with a marketing team,
But He’s wild in the whirlwind, He don’t fit your scheme.You quote verses, but you never let the Sword cut,
You talk “spirit,” but you never let the flesh shut.
Say “He’s love,” but you keep Him cold, distant, numb,
An emotionless idol where the real God ain’t welcome.
You say “Lord, Lord,” but you don’t know Him at all,
Raised up steeples, but you killed His call.
Turned His face into stone, made His voice so small,
But He still walks in the fire, yeah, He sees it all.You made God like you, with your fear and pride,
Put Him up in a box, left Him locked inside.
But He’s breaking through the walls that you fortified,
Every idol ‘bout to fall when the King arrives.
You painted Him weak, just a broken man hanging,
Forgot the empty tomb, left the Lion still caged in.
You preach half-cross, never talk crown,
So when He roars from the heavens, you don’t even bow down.You sell His Name like a brand on a shirt,
While the poor on your steps still covered in dirt.
Got smoke machines, but no cloud of His glory,
Your “worship set” never lines up with His story.You made Him tame, like He cosign your preferences,
Voted Him in to support your own prejudices.
But His eyes like fire, see straight through your lies,
Every false Jesus you built ‘bout to vaporize.
You say “Lord, Lord,” but you don’t know Him at all,
Raised up steeples, but you killed His call.
Turned His face into stone, made His voice so small,
But He still walks in the fire, yeah, He sees it all.
You pray safe prayers, ‘cause you doubt His might,
Act surprised when He move, like “That can’t be right.”
You call miracles “extreme,” call obedience “zeal,”
But you bow to the system, not the God who is real.You study Him deep, like a frog in a jar,
Poke at His Word, but you won’t let Him scar.
You want comfort, not covenant, programs not Presence,
Lecture ‘bout the King while you dodge His sentence.You say He don’t speak, but your volume too loud,
You drown out His whisper with your hype church crowd.
You built a kingdom where your name got fame,
But the Holy One outside still calling your name.
He ain’t your mascot, He ain’t your brand,
He’s the fire, the thunder, the nail-scarred hands.
He weeps with the broken, roars with the brave,
Tears down proud hearts, walks out of your grave.He’s mercy with a sword, kindness that convicts,
Truth that don’t bend for your politics.
He’s closer than breath, but higher than the sky,
The One who came low, now coming glorified.
So I step in the booth with a trumpet and a tear,
Spit war on religion ‘til the real God appear.
Let the walls shake, let the chandeliers swing,
‘Cause the Bridegroom coming and He ain’t no “nice thing.”This is for the ones locked in pews by fear,
Who feel His pull, but the cost too severe.
He calling you out past the stage and the lights,
To the raw, bloody place where His love ignites.Let the fake fall off, let the True One stand,
Not a concept, but the I AM in command.
No more hollow praise with a hollowed-out heart,
Let the Living One walk in, tear your masks apart.
You say “Lord, Lord,” but you don’t know Him at all,
Raised up steeples, but you killed His call.
Turned His face into stone, made His voice so small,
But He still walks in the fire, yeah, He sees it all.You made God like you, with your fear and pride,
Put Him up in a box, left Him locked inside.
But He’s breaking through the walls that you fortified,
Every idol ‘bout to fall when the King arrives.So let the dead church die, let the real Bride rise,
Let the Lion’s roar drown a million lies.
From the street to the altar, let the earth be shown:
The One you misrepresented… now makes Himself known.
